title: Latency-band region elector with network-integrity escrow and fallback variant mapping
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Problem: Region routing sometimes flips too aggressively on short-lived p95 spikes and overreacts to partial packet-loss signals, causing downstream higher request fanout and cost. We need an elector that makes deterministic region choices using latency bands (p50/p95), an additional network-integrity escrow score, and an explicit mapping to fallback model variants per tier so clients experience graceful degradations rather than hard fails.

Goal: Implement a latency-band based region elector that: (1) computes short and long window p50/p95 bands per region, (2) synthesizes a network-integrity escrow score from loss/jitter/trace-errors, (3) applies hysteresis and decay to avoid oscillations, (4) produces ranked region candidates with attached fallback model variant suggestions per tier, and (5) exposes simulation and dry-run modes for canary evaluation.

Why different from prior work: existing tickets focus on percentile scoring or net-health fusion; this ticket introduces explicit latency bands, an escrow concept (temporary capacity headroom reserved for safety), and a standardized fallback-variant map tied to customer tier and latency bands.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Elector API returns stable region ranking under short high-p95 spikes (no more than 1 switch per region per 10m in dry-run for controlled traffic).
2) Eviction decisions must include escrow deduction so we never route more than (capacity - escrow) during recovery windows.
3) For each routed fallback variant the elector returns: variant_id, expected latency band, and recommended batching/quantization profile.
4) New metrics: elector_switch_count, escrow_reserved_ms, variant_suggestion_rate are emitted and visible in Console.
5) End-to-end canary (10% production traffic) shows no user-visible error rate increase and cost delta <= +3%.
spec_notes:
Core components:
- Telemetry aggregator: compute sliding-window p50 & p95 for 3 windows: 30s, 5m, 30m.
- Latency bands: define bands (green: p95 < 120ms, amber: 120-350ms, red: >350ms) and p50 delta heuristics for jitter detection.
- Escrow scorer: translate packet-loss %, trace error rate, and RTT variance into a single escrow_ms reserved per region. Escrow decays exponentially with half-life 4m after signals stabilize.
- Hysteresis: require band to persist across 2 consecutive 30s windows OR be corroborated by escrow breach to flip.
- Variant map: JSON mapping per customer tier (free/standard/enterprise) associating target latency band -> fallback model variant and operational knobs (batch size cap, quant profile).
- API: elector/v1/choose returns ordered list of candidates with metadata and confidence score. Dry-run flag available.

Data retention & compute: aggregator runs as sidecar in routing pods and periodically (15s) posts region summary to elector service. Elector keeps last 3 windows.
implementation_plan:
Milestones:
- Week 1: Telemetry aggregator changes, latency band calculator (ENG: Diego, reviewer: Lena Huang).
- Week 2: Escrow scorer, hysteresis rules, unit tests.
- Week 3: Variant map schema, Console metric plumbing, dry-run endpoint.
- Week 4: Integration tests, chaos scenarios (induce p95 spikes, packet loss), canary rollout with 10% traffic.

Work breakdown: 1) telemetry schema updates (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pulls/342) 2) new elector service repo changes (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/elector/pulls/86) 3) console dashboards (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pulls/129) 4) docs (Confluence: /display/Routing/Latency+Band+Elector)
test_plan:
- Unit: deterministic tests for band transitions, escrow decay math, and variant map resolution.
- Integration: synthetic traffic replay: gaussian p50 with injected p95 spikes and controlled packet-loss to validate hysteresis and escrow behaviors.
- Load: ensure elector adds <5ms median CPU latency under 2000 region summaries/sec.
- Canary: 10% of traffic for 48h with metrics guardrails (error rate, latency p99, cost). Automated rollback if error rate increases >0.5pp or cost >3%.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature behind feature-flag per-cluster. 2) Dry-run for 72h against production telemetry to validate candidate ranking without influencing routing. 3) Canary at 10% traffic for 48h. 4) Ramp to 50% then 100% with monitoring and automatic rollback rules.
risks:
- Incorrect escrow calibration may underutilize capacity (cost).
- Hysteresis thresholds tuned too conservatively could delay failovers (latency regressions).
- Variant mapping complexity could cause incompatible model calls for some clients.
- Additional telemetry volume may increase sidecar CPU cost.
